parties:
Jinnat Ali (Md)  ----- Petitioner 
Vs 
Md Abdu Bakkar Siddique and others  ----- Opposite Parties
full_judgment: 3. opposite party No. 1 as pre-emptee contested the case by filing a written objection contending, inter alia that the case is barred by limitation and bad for defect of parties. It has further been alleged that two brothers Abdul Gafur Munshi and Abdul Aziz on purchase of land from the case plot had been in possession and during rent roll operation the names of Abdul Aziz and others were recorded correctly but the name of Abdul Gafur Munshi was recorded wrongly. Abdul Gafur died leaving a widow, a son and 3 daughters and said Abdul Aziz died leaving two sons and a daughter. It is also the case of the opposite) arty No. 1 that his cousin Habibur Rahman transferred some lands in his favour out of the case jote by Heba-bil Ewaz, Exhibit Ka and he also purchased 0.17 acres of land by sale deed No. 8748 dated 20-10-1988 and 0.19 acres by sale deed No. 8466 dated 15-10-88 from the case plot. He has further stated in the written objection that he made improvement of the case land by cutting earth worth Taka 8,000. It is also alleged that although he purchased the case land at a consideration of Taka 25,000 within the knowledge of the petitioner and at his advice he mentioned the purchase value at Taka 6,000 in the kabala and that the present price of the case land is about Taka 35,000.
